title: derive.py hardening: strict-JSON-safe malformed-cap transport + no-alias assumption copy + bounded reason echo (G5 LOW-1/LOW-2/LOW-3 fast-follow)
objective: Close the three G5 LOW findings on the accepted services/api/app/scenario/derive.py, additively and deterministically, WITHOUT changing any already-correct behaviour or the canonical cap VALUE. (LOW-1) In the not_derivable/invalid_assumption outcomes, transport canonical_cap_sq_ft only when it is finite; when the incoming cap is NaN/+/-Inf/negative, surface canonical_cap_sq_ft as null with a reason noting a malformed cap, so the output is ALWAYS strict-JSON-safe (json.dumps(out, allow_nan=False) never raises and no NaN/Inf/negative number ever appears in the output) even when derive() is called DIRECTLY with a malformed document (not via build_scenario). Add a strict-JSON-safety test over non-finite/negative injected caps. Do NOT alter the DERIVED-outcome cap transport (build_scenario always yields a positive-finite-or-None cap) - only the fail-closed outcomes are guarded. (LOW-2) In _copy_assumption, deepcopy the value/unit/rationale so an UNAPPLIED assumption carrying a nested-mutable value is never aliased to the input document; correct the docstring so it no longer over-claims 'never aliases the input' unless it is now literally true; prove with a test that mutating the derived object never reaches back into the scenario document. (LOW-3) Bound the length of any raw input echoed via repr()/str() into reason strings to a reasonable cap (e.g. truncate with an ellipsis) so a pathological 100k-char input cannot bloat a reason. HARD BOUNDARIES: contract-free (only derive.py + its test file); never edit builder.py/models.py/constants.py/contract.py or packages/contracts/**; the canonical cap VALUE is still transported verbatim on the DERIVED path and never recomputed; never emit verified; deterministic byte-identical output for identical input; every pre-existing derive + scenario test still passes. TOOL DISCIPLINE: orient with Read/Grep/Glob; do NOT use Bash for git/ls/cat/find; only WRITE files in allowed_paths and RUN documented_test_commands; the orchestrator commits at the gate.
business_reason: Closes the 3 LOW defense-in-depth findings from the M5-T005 G5 security review (strict-JSON-safety gap on a directly-called malformed cap, an input-aliasing gap + a false docstring claim, and an unbounded reason echo) BEFORE further optimization work builds on derive.py - keeps the accepted scenario module strict-JSON-safe and its docstrings honest. Non-blocking (all three unreachable via the trusted build_scenario pipeline) but low-cost to close; disciplined review->fix->accept cycle.
acceptance_scenarios: AS-1 strict-JSON-safe malformed cap (LOW-1): calling derive() DIRECTLY with a document whose draft_zoning_floor_area_cap_sq_ft is NaN / +Inf / -Inf / negative -> a not_derivable outcome whose canonical_cap_sq_ft is null (not the malformed number) with a reason noting the malformed cap; json.dumps(out, allow_nan=False) SUCCEEDS and no NaN/Inf/negative number appears anywhere in the output.

AS-2 DERIVED-path cap transport unchanged: a normal build_scenario document (positive-finite cap) still transports canonical_cap_sq_ft VERBATIM (value + type, e.g. int stays int); the no-assumptions passthrough and factor-derivation results are byte-identical to M5-T005 behaviour (no regression to the correct path).

AS-3 no-alias unapplied assumption (LOW-2): an UNAPPLIED assumption carrying a nested-mutable value ({"nested":[...]}) yields a derived object whose value is NOT the same object as the input (`is` is False); mutating the derived nested value never changes the input scenario document; the _copy_assumption docstring's aliasing claim is now literally true.

AS-4 bounded reason echo (LOW-3): a pathological large raw input (e.g. a 100k-char factor value or scenario_kind) echoed into a reason string is truncated to a bounded length (with an ellipsis marker), so no reason string grows unbounded.

AS-5 canonical cap value + never-Verified preserved: on the DERIVED path the cap value is never recomputed/relabelled; no output field == 'verified'; needs_review + not_verified_disclaimer lineage preserved.

AS-6 determinism + full regression: identical input -> byte-identical output; the ENTIRE scenario suite (python -m pytest services/api/tests/scenario) stays green with the new hardening tests added and zero regression to the pre-existing derive/contract/foundation tests.
